capabilities: render nomnoml code blocks as SVG diagrams
insert new diagram code blocks via command or slash command
set default nomnoml directive styles in plugin options
include rendered diagrams in PDF export
extras: Diagrams render as SVG with text nodes that remain annotatable in PDF export.
problem: Obsidian cannot render nomnoml diagram syntax, so users have no way to draw UML-style class diagrams from nomnoml code inside their notes.

relations.evidence: Please check nomnoml's official website and GitHub repository for the full syntax references and more examples!

summary: Diagram plugin that renders nomnoml code blocks in notes as SVG diagrams.
